import unittest
from models.entities import Product, Coupon
class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_max_uses(self):
        coupon_with_default_uses = Coupon(code="X", percent_off=10)
        self.assertEqual(coupon_with_default_uses.max_uses, 1)
        self.assertTrue(coupon_with_default_uses.validate())
        
        coupon_with_extra_uses = Coupon(code="Y", percent_off=10, max_uses=5)
        self.assertEqual(coupon_with_extra_uses.max_uses, 5)
        self.assertTrue(coupon_with_extra_uses.validate())
        
        coupon_with_zero_uses = Coupon(code="X", percent_off=10, max_uses=0)
        self.assertFalse(coupon_with_zero_uses.validate())

    def test_percent(self):
        self.assertFalse(Coupon(code="X", percent_off=0).validate())
        self.assertTrue(Coupon(code="X", percent_off=100).validate())
        self.assertTrue(Coupon(code="X", percent_off=50).validate())
